description: This file defines static classes for managing logging within the PDFsharp library. It provides a global logger factory, methods for creating loggers, and a reset function for testing scenarios.

classes.name: LogCategory
classes.description: Defines the logging categories used in PDFsharp, with a default category for the standard logger.

classes.name: LogHost
classes.description: Provides a singleton global logger factory, accessor for a default logger, methods to create loggers, and a reset method for testing purposes.

methods.name: Factory
methods.description: Property to get or set the global ILoggerFactory used for creating loggers.

methods.name: Logger
methods.description: Property to get the singleton default ILogger for PDFsharp logging.

methods.name: CreateLogger
methods.description: Creates a logger with a specified category name.

methods.name: CreateLogger<T>
methods.description: Creates a logger with the full name of type T as its category.

methods.name: ResetLogging
methods.description: Resets the logging host to its initial state — primarily useful for unit testing scenarios.
